newsitem.title: GREECE: BOMB WRECKS DUTCH EMBASSY JEEP IN CENTRAL ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: BOMB WRECKS DUTCH EMBASSY JEEP IN CENTRAL ATHENS.

text.p: A small bomb blast wrecked a jeep belonging to the Dutch embassy near the Panathinaiko stadium but caused no injuries, police said.

A group calling itself the "Revolutionary Front" claimed responsibility for the blast in a call to Skai television and said it was linked to the upcoming commemoration of the November 17, 1973, student uprising in Athens.
"The 1973 uprising shed light on today's struggles and revolutions," the anonymous caller told Skai. Police said they had not heard of the group before.
The 1973 student uprising at the Athens Polytechnic School helped to bring down the military junta which ruled from 1967 to 1974.
